Major NEJM/JAMA/Lancet/BMJ acute-care trial cross-check: the 10 general-journal memberships were screened; none met the in-window ED-practice threshold after triage.
ACEP clinical-policy cross-check: targeted official-domain/date search did not verify a new April 6-12, 2025 clinical policy; exhaustive dated archive coverage was not certified.
AHA/ASA guidance cross-check: targeted official search did not verify an in-window major stroke/cardiovascular statement; the 2025 ACS guideline was published earlier and is outside this window.
SCCM/sepsis cross-check: targeted official search did not identify a new April 6-12 SCCM/sepsis guideline; complete chronological archive coverage was not certified.
IDSA cross-check: targeted official search did not verify a new emergency-relevant IDSA guideline in the interval.
CHEST cross-check: targeted official search did not verify a new April 6-12 acute-care CHEST guideline; later April transfusion guidance is outside the window.
Hematology/bleeding/anticoagulation cross-check: no new in-window major ASH emergency guidance was verified by the targeted official search.
Toxicology cross-check: no new in-window ACMT/AACT clinical statement was verified by the targeted official search.
Trauma cross-check: ESTES European polytrauma consensus was primary-verified and selected; EAST/ACS targeted checks did not establish an additional in-window major US trauma guideline.
Pediatric emergency cross-check: no new April 6-12 major pediatric emergency guideline was verified in targeted AAP/society checks.
Obstetric emergency cross-check: no new April 6-12 major ACOG obstetric-emergency guidance was verified in the targeted check.

Historical/correction cross-check: ESTES has a September 10, 2025 author-name correction only; no selected WESTCOR correction was found. TENS and D-dimer candidates were reviewed but not promoted because evidence was small or lacked prospective management validation.

excludedCandidates.reason: Small single-center 80-patient TENS RCT for acute low back pain showed modest short-term benefit, but later small randomized evidence was inconsistent; insufficient to prioritize as practice-changing.

Large retrospective association between early noninvasive cardiac testing and 1-year outcomes is vulnerable to residual confounding and conflicts with broader low-risk chest-pain evidence; not selected.
Age-adjusted D-dimer DDU study was retrospective in patients already selected for CTPA and did not prospectively validate a safe diagnostic management strategy; not selected.
